habits.name: Daily Planning
habits.description: Aaj ke top-3 study goals likho (ek line each) — subah 9 baje se pehle, paper par.
habits.criteria: Top-3 goals paper par likhe hain, aaj ki date ke saath, 9 AM se pehle.

habits.name: Deep Work
habits.description: Har study block shuru karne se pehle phone doosre room mein rakho aur desk par sirf study material rakho.
habits.criteria: Har study block ke liye phone doosre room gaya; block bina interruption pura hua.

habits.name: Night Review
habits.description: Sone se pehle 3-sawal review likho: kya complete hua, sabse badi mistake, kal ka pehla task.
habits.criteria: Teeno sawalon ke jawab raat ko sone se pehle likhe gaye.

habits.name: Self-Discipline
habits.description: Har planned task ke liye chhota 5-min start karo — 'mann nahi kar raha' aaye toh bhi shuru karo.
habits.criteria: Koi planned task 'mann nahi kiya' ke excuse se skip nahi hua; har resistance pe 5-min start hua.

habits.name: Consistency
habits.description: Core tasks roz ek hi time par karo — bina miss, bina ghataye, bina badle.
habits.criteria: Aaj ke saare core tasks planned time par ho gaye, koi miss nahi.

habits.name: Time Management
habits.description: Aaj ke har study block ko exact clock time assign karo (start-end) aur usi par stick raho.
habits.criteria: Har block ka clock time likha hai aur 80%+ blocks usi time par chale.

habits.name: Goal Setting
habits.description: Week ka 1 clear goal likho (kya complete karna hai) aur roz uske against progress check karo.
habits.criteria: Weekly goal likha hai aur aaj uska 1-line progress note hua.

habits.name: Top 3 Priorities
habits.description: Roz ke top-3 goals mein se sabse high-impact ek ko highlight karo aur pehle wahi karo.
habits.criteria: Top-3 me se ek priority highlight hui aur aaj pehle usi par kaam hua.

habits.name: Task Management
habits.description: Din ke saare tasks (study + non-study) ek hi list mein likho, phir har task ko time block assign karo.
habits.criteria: Poori din ki task list ek jagah hai aur har task ko time assign hua.

habits.name: Single-tasking
habits.description: Ek study block mein sirf ek subject/topic rakho — beech mein switch mat karo.
habits.criteria: Har block mein sirf ek topic pada; koi beech-beech mein subject switch nahi.

habits.name: Focus & Concentration
habits.description: Block ke beech mein sirf planned breaks lo — phone/notifications beech mein check mat karo.
habits.criteria: Har block bina unplanned break ke pura hua; sirf planned breaks liye.

habits.name: Distraction Control
habits.description: Study shuru karne se pehle phone, notifications aur clutter desk se hata do.
habits.criteria: Study space clean hai — phone/notifications/clutter bahar; block isi setup se shuru hua.

habits.name: Execution
habits.description: Plan mein jo task likha hai wahi aaj actually karo — plan-do gap zero rakho.
habits.criteria: Aaj ke plan ka 100% execute hua; jitna plan kiya utna actually kiya.

habits.name: Finish Tasks
habits.description: Jo task shuru karo use usi din complete karo — adhoora mat chhodo.
habits.criteria: Shuru kiye gaye saare tasks aaj hi close hue; koi pending nahi.

habits.name: Preparation & Readiness
habits.description: Agle din ke saare study materials (books, notes, problems) raat ko hi ready rakho.
habits.criteria: Agle din ka material raat ko ready hai; subah kuch dhundhna nahi pada.

habits.name: Conceptual Understanding
habits.description: Naya concept padhne ke baad use apne shabdon mein, bina dekhe, likh ke explain karo.
habits.criteria: Concept ka 2-3 line explanation bina notes ke likha gaya jo kisi ko samjha sake.

habits.name: Why Thinking
habits.description: Har naye concept pe likho: 'yeh formula/concept kyun sahi hai?' — reason ke saath.
habits.criteria: Har naye concept ka 'kyun' reason likha hua hai.

habits.name: How & What-if Thinking
habits.description: Har concept ka 'yeh kaise use hota hai' likho + ek what-if variation solve karo.
habits.criteria: Concept ka real application + ek condition-change variation likha hua hai.

habits.name: Active Recall
habits.description: Bina notes dekhe, kal padha hua content 10 min likh ke test karo.
habits.criteria: Kal ka content bina dekhe likha gaya; jo nahi yaad woh note hua.

habits.name: Daily Revision
habits.description: Pichle 3 din ka content ek baar revise karo — formulas, key points, solved problems.
habits.criteria: Pichle 3 din ke main topics/formulas aaj revise hue (15-20 min).

habits.name: Mistake Logging
habits.description: Har galat question ko Mistake Log mein likho: question, galat step, sahi tarika.
habits.criteria: Aaj ke saare galat questions Mistake Log mein daale gaye hain.

habits.name: Error Analysis
habits.description: Har galat question ka root cause classify karo: concept gap / silly / time pressure / calculation.
habits.criteria: Har galat question ek category mein classify hua aur likha hua hai.

habits.name: Problem Decomposition
habits.description: Tough question ko solve karne se pehle chhote steps mein todo — kya diya, kya chahiye, kaise pahunchenge.
habits.criteria: Question ke 2-3 sub-steps pehle likhe gaye, phir solve kiya.

habits.name: Problem Solving (unseen)
habits.description: Roz minimum 5 unseen/pehli-baar dekhe questions attempt karo.
habits.criteria: Aaj 5+ unseen questions attempt hue (chaahe galat aaye — attempt zaroori).

habits.name: Logical Thinking
habits.description: Har solution ke har step ke peeche ka reason likho — 'yeh step kyun kiya'.
habits.criteria: Solution ke har step ka justification likha hua hai.

habits.name: Critical Thinking
habits.description: Answer verify karne se pehle socho: 'yeh answer galat kyun ho sakta hai?'
habits.criteria: Answer se pehle ek counter-reason socha gaya (likha hua).

habits.name: Analytical Thinking
habits.description: Solve shuru karne se pehle identify karo: 'yeh question kis concept se hai, kaunsa formula lagega'.
habits.criteria: Question ka concept/formula pehle identify hua, phir solve kiya.

habits.name: Observation
habits.description: Question ka saara given data pehle carefully note karo — units, values, conditions.
habits.criteria: Question ka poora given data solve karne se pehle likha hua hai.

habits.name: Detail Awareness
habits.description: Units, signs aur conditions ko har step mein check karo — miss mat karo.
habits.criteria: Koi unit/sign/condition miss nahi hua; har critical value check hui.

habits.name: Pattern Recognition
habits.description: Naya question dekhte hi socho: 'is jaisa similar question pehle kaunsa solve kiya tha?'
habits.criteria: Har naye question ke saath ek similar pehle-solved question match kiya.

habits.name: Verification
habits.description: Har solved answer ko alternate method ya estimation se verify karo.
habits.criteria: Har answer alternate method/estimate se verify hua.

habits.name: Double Checking
habits.description: Final answer likhne se pehle poora solution ek baar dobara re-read karo.
habits.criteria: Solution final se pehle ek baar re-read hua; koi badla hua step nahi.

habits.name: Progress Tracking
habits.description: Roz ka completion % note karo — kitna plan kiya, kitna complete hua.
habits.criteria: Aaj ka completion % likha hua hai.

habits.name: Performance Review
habits.description: Har mock/test ke baad structured review karo: marks, section-wise, mistakes, improvement.
habits.criteria: Test ka structured review likha gaya — 4 points ke saath.

habits.name: Daily Review (deep)
habits.description: Night review ko 5 sawalon ka deep review banao: progress, mistake, concept, tomorrow, consistency.
habits.criteria: 5-question deep night review aaj likha gaya.

habits.name: Weekly Review
habits.description: Har 7th din weekly review karo: week ka progress, weak areas, agle week ka plan.
habits.criteria: Weekly review session hua — data, weak spots, next-week plan likha.

habits.name: Self-Reflection (Month 1)
habits.description: Month 1 Reflection likho: strong habits, weak habits, agle phase ke adjustments.
habits.criteria: Month reflection likha — strong, weak, adjustments (3 sections).

habits.name: Evidence check
habits.description: Ek weak concept/test mistake uthao aur uspe claim, evidence, missing proof likho — padhai se pehle.
habits.criteria: Claim-evidence-missing-proof note likha hua hai ek topic pe.

habits.name: Assumption test on one JEE problem
habits.description: Solve karne se pehle ek problem ke 2 assumptions likho, phir solution ke baad verify karo.
habits.criteria: Do assumptions likhi hain aur solution ke baad verify hui hain.

habits.name: Reality review
habits.description: Planned vs actual study output compare karo aur kal ke liye ek correction likho.
habits.criteria: Plan-vs-actual likha hai + ek correction action note hua.

habits.name: Hypothesis drill for a tough concept
habits.description: Ek tough concept pe ek why/how hypothesis banao, notes/examples se test karo, result record karo.
habits.criteria: Hypothesis test karke result likha hua hai (sahi/ghalat + kyun).

habits.name: Find one counterexample
habits.description: Kisi formula/rule ka counterexample dhundo — kab fail hota hai, kya condition chahiye.
habits.criteria: Ek counterexample/fail-condition mila aur likha hua hai.

habits.name: Assumption log update
habits.description: Aaj ki ek galat assumption log karo aur uska corrected version likho.
habits.criteria: Ek assumption entry log hui (galat + corrected).

habits.name: 5-Why root cause on one mistake
habits.description: Ek repeated mistake pe 5-Why lagao jab tak real root cause specific na mil jaye.
habits.criteria: 5-Why chain likhi hui hai, specific root cause tak.

habits.name: One system fix for a recurring miss
habits.description: Ek chhota checklist/process banao jo repeated error ko prevent kare.
habits.criteria: Ek system fix (checklist/rule) likha hua hai aur use kiya gaya.

habits.name: Feedback loop close-out
habits.description: Kal ka fix review karo — kya problem kam hui ya nahi, mark karo.
habits.criteria: Kal ke fix ka result review hua (kam hua/nahi).

habits.name: Derive from first principles
habits.description: Ek formula/result ko memorize karne ki jagah definitions se derive karo.
habits.criteria: Formula derive kiya hua hai (2-3 line derivation).

habits.name: Probability estimate before answer
habits.description: Calculation se pehle answer ka range/sign estimate karo, phir solve kar ke compare karo.
habits.criteria: Answer estimate likha + actual se compare kiya.

habits.name: Principle map for a chapter
habits.description: Ek chapter ke topic ko uske core laws + common question patterns se map karo.
habits.criteria: Chapter ka principle map banaya — laws + patterns likhe.

habits.name: Bias check before judging performance
habits.description: Aaj ki performance ka faisla karne se pehle 3 bullets mein facts vs feelings alag karo.
habits.criteria: Facts-feelings 3-3 bullets mein alag likhe hain.

habits.name: Independent solution attempt
habits.description: Ek problem ko hint/solution dekhne se pehle poora khud attempt karo.
habits.criteria: Ek problem khud attempt hui (chaahe incomplete) hint se pehle.

habits.name: Objective review of a wrong answer
habits.description: Galat answer ka review likho: data kya bolta hai — concept/calculation/interpretation/time.
habits.criteria: Galat answer ki category identify + likhi hui hai.

habits.name: One deep why question
habits.description: Ek concept connection ke peeche ka deep 'why' puchho aur khud jawab do.
habits.criteria: Ek deep why question + jawab likha hua hai.

habits.name: Link two topics
habits.description: Do related topics ko chapters/subjects ke across ek example se connect karo.
habits.criteria: Do topics ka connection example ke saath likha hua hai.

habits.name: Knowledge gap capture
habits.description: Aaj mile ek gap ko likho + exact source/action jo use band kare.
habits.criteria: Ek gap + source/action likha hua hai.

habits.name: Attention reset before study block
habits.description: Study block se pehle 60-second reset karo: desk saaf, phone door, target saamne.
habits.criteria: Reset kiya — desk clean, phone door, target visible.

habits.name: Question condition scan
habits.description: 3 problems solve karne se pehle unki saari conditions underline/list karo.
habits.criteria: 3 problems ki conditions pehle list hui hain.

habits.name: Vigilance review
habits.description: Aaj ek missed condition/sign/unit record karo aur prevention cue likho.
habits.criteria: Ek miss + prevention cue log hua.

habits.name: Precision checklist run
habits.description: Aaj ke sabse tough solved problem pe units/signs/boundary checklist chalao.
habits.criteria: Checklist run hui — units/signs/boundary checked.

habits.name: Adapt plan from evidence
habits.description: Latest performance ke hisaab se plan ka ek item change karo.
habits.criteria: Ek plan item evidence ke hisaab se badla hua hai.

habits.name: Decision log
habits.description: Kal ke liye ek keep/skip decision reason ke saath likho.
habits.criteria: Ek decision + reason likha hua hai.

habits.name: Best/base/worst study scenario
habits.description: Aaj ka plan best/base/worst time blocks ke saath banao.
habits.criteria: Teeno scenarios ke time blocks likhe hain.

habits.name: Add buffer for biggest risk
habits.description: Sabse bada schedule risk identify karo aur ek backup slot add karo.
habits.criteria: Risk + backup slot likha hua hai.

habits.name: Scenario review at night
habits.description: Raat ko check karo kaunsa scenario hua aur kal kya adjust karna hai.
habits.criteria: Scenario check hua + adjustment likha.

habits.name: Rank tasks by marks impact
habits.description: Aaj ke tasks ko JEE marks impact se rank karo — comfort se nahi.
habits.criteria: Tasks marks-impact order mein rank hue hain.

habits.name: Do highest-impact task first
habits.description: Sabse high-impact task pe pehle minimum 25 min kaam karo.
habits.criteria: Highest-impact task aaj sabse pehle 25+ min kiya gaya.

habits.name: Cut one low-value activity
habits.description: Aaj ek low-value task/distraction hatao ya chhota karo.
habits.criteria: Ek low-value activity cut hui/ghati hai.

habits.name: Prepare study resources upfront
habits.description: Block se pehle notes, PYQs, timer, formula sheet sab ready rakho.
habits.criteria: Saare resources block se pehle ready the.

habits.name: Clean one topic folder/list
habits.description: Ek chapter ke pending questions/resources ko clear buckets mein organize karo.
habits.criteria: Ek chapter ka folder/queue organized hua.

habits.name: Resource review
habits.description: Ek missing resource note karo aur kab collect karoge likho.
habits.criteria: Missing resource + deadline likhi hui hai.

habits.name: Explain one concept aloud
habits.description: Ek concept ko bina notes ke simple language mein aloud samjhao (apne aap se).
habits.criteria: Concept aloud explain hua — 2-3 min, bina notes.

habits.name: Confidence rep
habits.description: Ek timed question solve karo aur likho isse confidence kya badha.
habits.criteria: Timed question solve + confidence note likha.

habits.name: Write one precise doubt
habits.description: Ek doubt ko context + attempt + exact stuck point ke saath frame karo.
habits.criteria: Doubt 3 parts mein likha hua hai (context, attempt, stuck).

habits.name: Finish a resistance block
habits.description: Jis task se sabse zyada bhaag rahe ho, uspe 20 min kaam karo.
habits.criteria: Resistance task pe 20 min kiya gaya.

habits.name: Commitment check
habits.description: Likho: yeh goal kyun matter karta hai + agle block ke liye ek promise.
habits.criteria: Why + 1 promise likha hua hai.

habits.name: Restart fast after slip
habits.description: Distract ho jaao toh 2 min ke andar restart karo aur trigger log karo.
habits.criteria: Trigger log hua + 2 min mein restart kiya.

habits.name: Reframe one weakness as trainable
habits.description: Ek weak area ko concrete practice plan mein badlo.
habits.criteria: Weakness ka practice plan likha hua hai.

habits.name: Self-evaluate today honestly
habits.description: Aaj ka focus, accuracy, consistency score karo — har ek ka ek reason.
habits.criteria: 3 scores + 3 reasons likhe hain.

habits.name: One improvement rep
habits.description: Ek pehle galti-wala question/concept dobara karo aur improvement verify karo.
habits.criteria: Old mistake repeat hui + improvement verified.

habits.name: Label stress before reacting
habits.description: Study se pehle emotion, trigger, aur next best action ka naam lo.
habits.criteria: Emotion + trigger + action likha hua hai.

habits.name: Two-minute breathing reset
habits.description: Mock/revision block se pehle 2-min calm breathing reset karo.
habits.criteria: 2-min breathing reset hua.

habits.name: Pressure review
habits.description: Stress ne decisions ko kaise affect kiya likho + ek correction.
habits.criteria: Stress effect + correction likha hua hai.

habits.name: Sleep plan lock
habits.description: Bedtime/wakeup fix karo aur sleep se 30 min pehle study band.
habits.criteria: Sleep time locked + 30 min shutdown kiya.

habits.name: Recovery walk/stretch
habits.description: Energy bachane ke liye 10 min walk/stretch karo.
habits.criteria: 10-min walk/stretch hua.

habits.name: Energy review
habits.description: Sleep/energy rate karo aur kal ka load adjust karo.
habits.criteria: Energy rate hui + kal ka load adjust.

habits.name: Exam-day protocol rehearsal
habits.description: Admit-card/material/time/checklist mentally rehearse karo aur gaps log karo.
habits.criteria: Protocol rehearse hua + gaps logged.

habits.name: Final revision only
habits.description: Sirf formulae/mistake log revise karo — naye topics nahi (unless critical).
habits.criteria: Revision sirf formulae/mistake-log par hui.

habits.name: Lifelong system reflection
habits.description: Woh 3 systems likho jo is 90-day cycle ke baad bhi rakhoge.
habits.criteria: 3 lifelong systems likhe hain.
